Container.Name: bafft
Container.Overview: bafft: TTRPG campaign manager (world entities, session transcription and labelling, table soundboard). Single-user; set BAFFT_PASSWORD to require browser HTTP Basic authentication.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: HTTP port for the web app + API

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: SQLite db, session audio, pictures, soundboard clips. Must be owned by uid 1000 (the image runs as node, uid 1000): chown -R 1000:1000 once, or SQLITE_CANTOPEN.

Config.Name: BAFFT_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Optional HTTP Basic password (any username). Blank: open to anyone who can reach the port. GET /api/health remains public.

Config.Name: BAFFT_MAX_UPLOAD_MB
Config.Description: Maximum size per uploaded audio file in MB (1 MB = 1048576 bytes). Oversize uploads receive HTTP 413.

Config.Name: ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY
Config.Description: Session transcription (the default ASR provider). Blank: transcription uses the mock.

Config.Name: GEMINI_API_KEY
Config.Description: Drafting and pictures. Blank: those fall back to mocks.
